title: RSSB Conductor Final Result 2026
postName: Conductor – Rajasthan State Road Transport / related Conductor recruitment 2024
vacancyDetails: Result and category-wise cutoff for RSSB / RSMSSB Conductor recruitment 2024 cycle
qualification: As per RSSB Conductor 2024 notification (typically 10+2 / intermediate with other conditions)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Result with Cutoff → Document Verification / Skill stages (if any) → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Roll number; educational certificates, domicile, category certificate, photo ID for DV
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in or RSSB official portal
2. Open Results section
3. Download Conductor 2024 Result / Cutoff PDF
4. Search roll number and note cutoff category-wise
5. Follow DV schedule if shortlisted
shortDescription: RSSB Conductor 2024 Result with cutoff marks released. Check PDF on rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in.
content:
Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB / RSMSSB) has released the Conductor 2024 Result along with cutoff marks.

The official PDF generally contains selected / shortlisted roll numbers and category-wise minimum cutoff for further process.

What is included

  • Result list / shortlist
  • Category-wise cutoff (where published)
  • Instructions for document verification

Download only from the official Rajasthan board website and prepare documents if your roll number appears in the list.
